scope: Actual self-module lengths and local structure of K[t]/(t^m) and the literal bivariate quotient K[x,y]/(x^m,y-x), for every field K and natural m. A generic nilpotent power-basis lemma constructs actual multiplication-closed tail ideals and a strict chain, deriving ring-module length=power-basis dimension via restriction-of-scalars upper bound. Actual monic AdjoinRoot powerbasis and unchanged proved bivariate algebra equivalence instantiate the lemma. Positive m gives actual local rings and geometric support cardinality1 over every extension field; zero m gives length0 and nonlocal zero ring. Arbitrarily large local ring length occurs with support1. Actual F4/F2 residue-degree control has local ring length1 and scalar length2, directly disproving equality without residue-field qualification. No ring-length/locality/cycle/intersection/native result is supplied as a premise. Advances item8 actual local-algebra accounting, not general Diem multihomogeneous isolated-cycle/localization/intersection bound or JV ring length8. Established composition-length method and primary/prior sources credited, no novelty/source-refutation claim. Independent native written-header check is procedural, not kernel parser/hash/execution refinement. Standard foundations/defaults; no holes/custom axioms/native proof evaluation/global flags/raised limits/waivers/new cryptographic experiment/paid compute/agent upload.
